_comment: Canonical entry point for discovering and traversing the Brain. Empty owner and timestamps are intentional architecture placeholders.

_meta.description: Manifest and navigation contract for the canonical professional knowledge graph.

description: Permanent source of truth for verified professional knowledge. Generated artifacts are downstream outputs and must not be written back as facts.

modules.name: identity
modules.description: Professional identity, positioning, values, trajectory, and non-negotiable representation constraints.
questionsAnswered: Who is the owner professionally?
What problems do they solve?
What reputation should generated outputs reinforce?

modules.name: experience
modules.description: Rich employment context, responsibilities, outcomes, lessons, and linked evidence.
questionsAnswered: What did the owner do in each role?
Which outcomes and stories support that work?

modules.name: achievements
modules.description: Atomic, measurable outcomes with confidence and supporting evidence.
questionsAnswered: What measurable impact has the owner produced?
How strong is the evidence for each claim?

modules.name: projects
modules.description: Employer-independent initiatives describing problems, approaches, results, and lessons.
questionsAnswered: Which initiatives demonstrate a capability?
How was a problem approached and what resulted?

modules.name: skills
modules.description: Categorized capabilities with proficiency and evidence links.
questionsAnswered: What can the owner do?
What evidence supports each capability?

modules.name: technologies
modules.description: Tools and platforms with proficiency, use cases, recency, and evidence.
questionsAnswered: Which technologies has the owner used?
Where and how were they applied?

modules.name: industries
modules.description: Industry knowledge, affinity, experience, and supporting context.
questionsAnswered: Which industries does the owner understand or prefer?
What supports that industry knowledge?

modules.name: voice
modules.description: Writing style, editorial guardrails, and instructions for faithful generated language.
questionsAnswered: How should generated language sound?
Which writing patterns must AI avoid?

modules.name: preferences
modules.description: Career targets, working conditions, constraints, and deal breakers.
questionsAnswered: Which opportunities fit the owner?
Which constraints or deal breakers apply?

modules.name: management
modules.description: Leadership, mentoring, feedback, coaching, delegation, and team preferences.
questionsAnswered: How does the owner lead and develop people?
Which environment supports their leadership?

modules.name: interview-stories
modules.description: Reusable STAR stories with competencies, lessons, and evidence relationships.
questionsAnswered: Which story demonstrates a competency?
What situation, action, and result support an interview answer?

modules.name: writing
modules.description: Writing, research, interviewing, story discovery, structuring, and review methodology.
questionsAnswered: How does the owner create and review written work?
How are stories researched and structured?

modules.name: resume-strategy
modules.description: Rules for transforming verified Brain knowledge into temporary ResumeDocument outputs.
questionsAnswered: How should verified accomplishments be selected for a resume?
When should a derived resume use one or two pages?

relationships.description: Source evidence or context substantiates a claim.
An entity provides evidence of a skill or competency.
An entity is a component of a broader entity.
An outcome, project, or story occurred within an experience.
An entity applies a technology, skill, method, or domain.
An action or project produced an outcome.
A symmetric association when no more precise predicate applies.

navigation._comment: Instructions for retrieval and reasoning agents.
navigation.startHere: Select modules by questionsAnswered, then traverse relatedObjects using the relationship vocabulary.
navigation.sourceOfTruth: Only records in module data arrays are factual Brain knowledge.
navigation.documentationBoundary: _template, _example, schema, _comment, questionsAnswered, and _meta are documentation and must never be treated as owner facts.
navigation.generationBoundary: ResumeDocument and all other generated artifacts are temporary projections; they may cite Brain records but cannot silently create or mutate knowledge.
navigation.evidencePolicy: Prefer records with direct evidence and higher confidence. Preserve provenance and never exaggerate beyond supported facts.
